#!/bin/bash

else
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 "${REPO_BASE}/run.sh" -o /mnt/server/run.sh 2>/dev/null || true

fi
ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "${ARCH}" in x86_64|amd64) ARCH_TYPE="amd64" ;; aarch64|arm64) ARCH_TYPE="arm64" ;; esac

chmod +x /mnt/server/bin/minio 2>/dev/null || true
chown -R 988:988 /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || true
